parameters.query:
-- §10.3 Node 1: Fetch matching products by category or name
SELECT id, name, description, price, category, stock, variants, image_url, tags
FROM products
WHERE
  business_id = '{{ $json.business_id }}'
  AND is_active = true
  AND stock > 0
  AND (
    category ILIKE '{{ $json.entities?.product_category ?? '' }}'
    OR to_tsvector('english', name) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', '{{ $json.entities?.product_name ?? '' }}')
    OR name ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.entities?.product_name ?? '' }}' || '%'
  )
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN 'best seller' = ANY(tags) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
LIMIT 3;

-- §10.3 Node 2: Fetch best applicable discount rule
-- Best = highest discount value, most specific category match
SELECT
  id, rule_name, product_category, min_quantity, max_quantity,
  discount_type, discount_value, valid_from, valid_to
FROM discount_rules
WHERE
  business_id = '{{ $json.business_id }}'
  AND is_active = true
  AND min_quantity <= '{{ $json.entities?.quantity ?? 1 }}'
  AND (max_quantity IS NULL OR max_quantity >= '{{ $json.entities?.quantity ?? 1 }}')
  AND (valid_from IS NULL OR valid_from <= CURRENT_DATE)
  AND (valid_to   IS NULL OR valid_to   >= CURRENT_DATE)
  AND (
    product_category IS NULL
    OR product_category ILIKE '{{ $json.entities?.product_category ?? '' }}'
  )
ORDER BY
  -- Category-specific rules rank first
  CASE WHEN product_category IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  -- Then by highest discount value
  discount_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Fetch Discount Rule
nodes.notes: §10.3 Node 2: Fetches the single best-applicable discount rule. No stacking.

nodes.name: Calculate Bulk Pricing
nodes.notes: §10.3 Node 3: Pure JS pricing calculation. Applies percentage or fixed_price discount. Never stacks rules.

nodes.notes: §10.3 Node 5: Sends pricing breakdown. Text-based CONFIRM/AGENT CTA since WAHA doesn't reliably support native interactive buttons.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: `You are ${$json.business_name ?? ""}'s friendly WhatsApp sales assistant. Reply in the customer's language (${$json.language ?? ""}).

Tone: warm, concise, like a helpful shop assistant — not corporate, not robotic. Use at most 1–2 relevant emoji.

You are given:
- Customer intent: BULK_ORDER
- Matched product(s): ${$json.products_json ?? ""}
- Applicable discount: ${$json.discount_json ?? ""}
- Order pricing breakdown: ${$json.pricing_json ?? ""}

Format rules:
- If there is a stock error in pricing_json, politely apologize that we only have X units available, and ask if they would like to buy the available amount instead (do not quote pricing in this case).
- Show the pricing as a clear line-by-line breakdown:
  Product name, unit price × quantity = subtotal, then discount applied, then final total.
- End with: 'Reply CONFIRM to place this order, or AGENT to talk to our team.'
- Never invent prices — use only the figures in pricing_json.
- Keep reply under 200 words.\n\nCustomer Message: ${$json.messageText ?? ""}` }] }] }) }}
